svg.title: How IBM describes API Connect: build, publish, protect
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Build: API Studio unites authoring, testing and governance, all managed as code. Publish: developers discover APIs in the Developer Portal, and REST APIs are republished as MCP tools for agents. Protect: DataPower Gateway secures traffic, and Akamai Advanced API Security for IBM monitors for API attacks.
